scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.test:imap: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/imap-test-server/run.ts -- ./node_modules/.bin/electron ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --no-file-parallelism packages/adapter-imap/test/integration apps/desktop/test/integration
scripts.test:e2e: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && playwright install ffmpeg && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/imap-test-server/run.ts -- playwright test -c apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:demo: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && playwright install ffmpeg && playwright test -c apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts demo
scripts.bench:launch: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/bench-launch.ts
scripts.smoke:desktop: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/smoke-desktop.ts
scripts.smoke:desktop:sync: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/smoke-desktop-sync.ts
scripts.smoke:identity: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/smoke-identity.ts
scripts.smoke:instance: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/smoke-instance.ts
scripts.bundle:macos: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/bundle-macos.ts
scripts.release:macos: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && MATTERS_RELEASE=1 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/bundle-macos.ts && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/release-macos.ts
scripts.smoke:security: cd apps/desktop && ./node_modules/.bin/electron-vite build && cd ../.. && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron tools/smoke-security.ts
